title: Orbiting Objectives: Initiative Convergence & Sprint Cadence
creator: Lina Patel
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable Playbook and cadence that ties company-level OKRs to initiative scoping, sprint commitments, and a cross-functional escalation path. Motivation: current quarterly planning produces dense initiative lists that are difficult to reconcile across product, infra, and GTM; teams are shipping surface-level features that don't map cleanly to outcome metrics. Deliver a one-page orchestration model + templated artifacts (initiative brief, sprint gating checklist, escalation matrix) and pilot with two initiatives in Q3.
acceptance_criteria: One-page orchestration model published to Confluence with versioned template
Initiative brief template adopted by 2 pilot squads and populated for their Q3 initiatives
Cadence schedule (planning -> weekly sync -> gating -> retro) documented and added to company calendar with owners
Automated dependency registry created in linear (issue links) and verified for pilot initiatives
Success metrics and signals defined for each pilot initiative and wired into the OKR dashboard
